topic: Open-source video models caught up this month
angle: The gap between free weights and paid APIs closed faster than anyone planned for
hook: Open video models just caught the paid ones
caption:
A year ago open video generation was a toy. This month the open-weight models are producing output people cannot reliably distinguish from the paid APIs, and several ship licences that permit commercial use outright. The catch is hardware, not quality.

🔖 Save this — you'll want it when it's relevant.

#ai #opensource #aivideo #aitools #contentcreation

slides.text: Open video models just caught the *paid* ones
slides.subline: And the licences are better than you think

slides.text: The quality argument is basically over. What is left is a hardware argument, and that one is still real.

slides.title: Read the licence first
slides.body: Licences travel with the weights, not the hardware. Free GPU does not make a non-commercial model commercial, and several popular ones are non-commercial.

slides.caption: what an A100 costs to rent when you do not own a GPU

slides.title: Where this actually lands
slides.body: You do not need to own hardware. You need to know which model has a licence you can build on, and rent the rest by the hour.

slides.text: You won't see this anywhere else
